AGENDA

  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting
  APPROVED AS AMENDED

  Thursday, May 16, 2024, at 10:00 a.m.
1.  ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on May 16, 2024, at 10:04 a.m.
  •  Present: Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian Zadorian, Pogosian, Chairperson Vidor
  •  Absent: Student Commissioner Aleksandryan
  The Agenda for the May 16, 2024, Regular Meeting was posted on May 13, 2024, on the Bulletin
  Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
  Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
  request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the April 18, 2024 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting.

  Moved:  Vice Chair Yank
  Seconded :  Commissioner Zadorian

  Ayes:  Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Viar, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Tufenkian, Aleksandryan, Pogosian

3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Loreto Lopez, Program Coordinator
  • Ms. Lopez gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts &
  Culture locations.

4. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS - None

5. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report. - No Speakers

6. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Arts and Culture Commission – Sponsorship Guidelines
  1. Note and file.

  •  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave a brief update. The Commission asked questions and gave their input.

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby receives, notes and files the updates to the Arts and
  Culture Commission’s Sponsorship Guidelines, as more fully outlined in the May 16, 2024 Report by
  the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator.
  1
   Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Commissioner Yank

  Ayes:  Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Aleksandryan, Pogosian

  b. Armenian Film Society - Sponsorship Opportunity
  1. Motion approving (1) the funding of a proposal by the Armenian Film Society to
  provide arts programming associated with the Armenian Film Festival from September
  4 - 8, 2024, and (2) the sponsorship of the Armenian Film Festival, in an amount not to
  exceed $5,000 from the 2024-2025 Work Plan.

  •  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones invited Armen Karaoghlanian, CEO and founder of the Armenian Film Society
  to give a brief presentation of his proposal to the Commission. The Commission asked questions
  and gave their input.

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves (1) the funding of a proposal by the Armenian
  Film Society to provide programming associated with the Armenian Film Festival from September 4 – 8,
  2024, and (2) the sponsorship of programming in an amount not to exceed $10,000 from the 2024 –
  2025 Work Plan, as more fully outlined in the May 16, 2024 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s
  Principal Arts & Culture Administrator.

  Moved:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Seconded :  Commissioner Tufenkian

  Ayes:  Vice Chair Yank, Commissioners Tufenkian, Zadorian, Chairperson Vidor
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None
  Abstain:  Commissioners Aleksandryan, Pogosian

7. DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. Be the Change: Armat – Armenian History Celebration Event
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones invited Library, Arts & Culture staff members Edit Vosganians and Sarah
  Walker to present an summary of the Armat: Armenian History Celebration event that happened on
  April 13, 2024. The Commission asked questions and gave their input.

  b. Display of Public Art in City-Owned Facilities – Guidelines and Procedures
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones opened discussion item. The Commission discussed recommended guidelines
  and procedures for the display of public art in city-owned facilities.
  Chairperson Vidor stated she wanted to elaborate and stated that the Commission does have a
  standard operating procedure on handling of donated works and how its reviewed and wants to look
  at expanding the existing procedure to include criteria for what the Commission and Staff approve
  of and don’t approve of.

  c. 2023-2024 Work Plan Progress Updates

  •  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave a brief update on the following items. The Commission asked questions
  and gave their input.

  i.  Mural Ordinance – Update:

  2
   •  Staff is working with the City Attorney’s Office on the final draft of the Mural Ordinance.
  The final draft Mural Ordinance is scheduled for initial review by the Commission at an
  upcoming Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.

  ii.  Creative Crosswalks: South Verdugo Road - Update:
  • Library, Arts & Culture staff have been working with Public Works staff to incorporate
  seven Creative Crosswalks to be located at two intersections as part of the South Verdugo
  Road Multi Modal Improvements Project. Staff shared the proposed designs.

  iii.  Student Ex-Officio Commissioners – Application now open
  • The application for Student Ex-Officio Commissioners is now open. The deadline to apply
  is July 15, 2024.

b. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS
  i.  Beyond the Box – Update:
  • Staff updated the application timeline up for this year’s Beyond the Box program in order
  to encourage students to apply for the program. The application for this year’s Beyond the
  Box program is currently open and closes on June 21, 2024. The theme of this year’s
  Beyond the Box program is “Art & Science Collide” in celebration of Glendale Library, Arts
  & Culture’s participation in the Getty PST Art Initiative.

c. PERFORMING ARTS – No update.
d. ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No update.

8. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  • Commissioner Tufenkian thanked Staff for all their hard work.
  • Commissioner Zadorian gave a shout out to the Armenian Genocide Committee for putting on an
  amazing week of events at the Alex Theatre for Armenian Heritage month, one being the Poets
  Against Genocide that involved children’s events. She also gave a specific shout out to
  Stephanie Mkhlian, Legislative Affairs and Communications Manager of the City of Glendale and
  Nairi Bandari of GTV6 and is looking forward to next year.
  • Chairperson Vidor suggested the Commission should start considering involvement with the 2028
  Olympics. She stated that she hopes the Commission and the Arts are a part of the planning process
  and wondered if the City of Glendale has started a process to be involved. Ms. Fukutomi- Jones
  stated it was a great recommendation and that the very least for now the Commission can entertain
  the idea of having a sub-committee. Chair Vidor stated that she hopes that sometime in the near
  future it can become an agenda item.

9. ADJOURNMENT 11:02 a.m.

  Moved:  Chairperson Vidor
  Seconded :  Commissioner Zadorian

The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday, June
20, 2024, at 10:00 AM in City Council Chambers – 613 E. Broadway Glendale, CA 91206.
